audited_finding: Upstream Step1 filters genes, fits HVG and prepares DE before splitting; normalize_per_cell(None) also derives a global target from all cells.
E156_decision: Do not reuse for the E156 primary assets; fit all cross-cell parameters on train only.

audited_finding: ListMLE sorts scores by y_n, then applies -sum(log_softmax(sorted_scores)); that sum is permutation-invariant, so y_n ordering has no mathematical effect.
E156_decision: Keep train-only y_n for native interface compatibility, but do not claim it drives ranking learning.

audited_finding: Native test_step reconstructs both pred and truth from PCA10; it does not return raw graph y as truth.
E156_decision: The frozen primary Pearson endpoint must use PCA10-reconstructed truth for P1/P2 comparability; raw normalized truth is sensitivity only.

audited_finding: Forward prediction consumes control-expression x plus perturbation identity; held-out target y/y_pca are loss/evaluation fields.
E156_decision: Serialize validation y/y_pca only; E158 may create test truth after E157 checkpoint and task scores are locked.
